last_episode_to_air.name: Live Your Fashion, Part 1
last_episode_to_air.overview: Bella, Skyler, Violet, and Kia are completing their study abroad adventure in the fashion capital of the world! Their biggest assignment yet? LIVE YOUR FASHION, meaning they wear the outfits they designed all day long before an unforgettable runway exam inside the Eiffel Tower!  But keeping couture clean in Paris isn't easy. Kia has met someone special and plans her first date.  Bella discovers a challenge she never expected.  Skyler searches for creative inspiration.  Violet takes on a very fashionable new job as a personal assistant. This is only the beginning of an unforgettable Paris adventure filled with friendship, fashion, romance, and surprises around every corner!

name: Rainbow High
overview: Legend says at the end of the rainbow, there's a pot of gold. But the truth is, it's something even more amazing. Only a chosen few with an eye for bold fashions can follow the rainbow to Rainbow High, the colorful fashion school where everyone learns to flaunt their true color.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The popular fashion dolls come to life in this animated series as they let their talents and true colors shine at the visual arts school, Rainbow High.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: New arrivals shake things up, old friendships are put to the test and the glamour levels fly off the charts, as always, at Rainbow High.

seasons.name: Rainbow Vision
seasons.overview: The Rainbow High crew prepares to face their rivals in a televised music competition while dealing with the typical ups and downs of high school.

seasons.name: Project Rainbow
seasons.overview: Sixteen lucky students from Rainbow High and Shadow High will work together to create the best fashions designs in Project Rainbow!

seasons.name: Rainbow World
seasons.overview: Best friends Bella, Ruby, Poppy, Sunny, Jade, Skyler, Violet, and Amaya have been chosen by Ms. Morton for a very important mission: the people in Rainbow World have lost their sparkle and they must work together to help others shine bright!

seasons.name: Rainbow World: Crystal Quest
seasons.overview: The girls are starting their Crystal Quest to save Rainbow World! Will they find the crystals and save the day?

seasons.name: Pretty In Paris
seasons.overview: Bella, Skyler, Violet, and Kia are completing their study abroad adventure in the fashion capital of the world!
